title: GLM-5.3-Flash CSF on two Sparks (a pair) with SparkCache persistent context (research-only)
evidence_scope: Research-only composition. The profile serves the CSF checkpoint (local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD at dec48abd33ef) with the cache-off profile's speed settings (MTP3, --async-scheduling, the B12X backends and coalescing, SIRCL tuning rows) plus SparkCache: the glm53-flash-hybrid model profile, connector-jobs asynchronous page capture against the lease contract vllm-connector-jobs-gab86b70.json of the derived image layer runtime/images/compositions/installer-sparkcache-gab86b70, CUDA page restore, tail-cow-v2 publication, 64K-token spans and a /cache/glm53-flash-sparkcache-ab53c097d7ca-dec48abd33ef cache root. It installs only on an image whose lock lists it: no lock of this package does; only the lock that the derived layer's record step writes does (runtime/releases/dev-20261010-sparkcache-gab86b70-plugins-status036/). The SparkCache profile glm53-flash-hybrid was qualified on shared release 2026.09.3 for TP2/DCP1 and TP4/DCP1 with MTP3 on other checkpoints and another vLLM line; no installation of this profile has run on hardware: its stage of performance/sparkcache-flash-csf-hardware-test-plan.md was pending when the four-Spark variant's record was written (performance/records/images/dev-20261010-sparkcache-gab86b70-plugins-status036-glm53-flash-nvfp4-sparkcache-tp4-path4-20261011.md), and no run combines SparkCache with 2,048-token split pages or async scheduling at TP2. Not serving-qualified.
